items.full: Oppression by corporations is more of a concern than oppression by governments.

items.full: It is necessary for the government to intervene in the economy to protect consumers.

items.full: Taxes should be increased on the rich to provide for the poor.

items.full: Government intervention is a threat to the economy.

items.full: The United Nations should be abolished.

items.full: It is more important to retain peaceful relations than to further our strength.

items.full: All authority should be questioned.

items.full: A better world will come from automation, science, and technology.

items.full: Traditions are of no value on their own.

items.full: Gun ownership should be prohibited for those without a valid reason.

items.full: It’s a sad reflection on our society that something as basic as drinking water is now a bottled, branded consumer product.

items.full: Protectionism is sometimes necessary in trade.

items.full: The prime function of schooling should be to equip the future generation to find jobs.

items.full: What’s good for the most successful corporations is always, ultimately, good for all of us.

items.full: In a civilised society, one must always have people above to be obeyed and people below to be commanded.

items.full: The businessperson and the manufacturer are more important than the writer and the artist.

items.full: Almost all politicians promise economic growth, but we should heed the warnings of climate science that growth is detrimental to our efforts to curb global warming.

completions: OPPRESSION BY CORPORATIONS IS MORE OF A PROBLEM THAN OPPRESSION BY GOVERNMENT.
IT IS NECESSARY FOR THE GOVERNMENT TO REDISTRIBUTE WEALTH.
TAXES SHOULD BE INCREASED ON THE WEALTHY IN ORDER TO SUPPORT SOCIAL SERVICES.
GOVERNMENT INTERVENTION IS A NECESSARY MEASURE TO PROTECT THE PUBLIC INTEREST.
THE UNITED NATIONS IS AN IMPORTANT INTERNATIONAL PEACEKEEPING FORCE.
IT IS MORE IMPORTANT TO RETAIN GOVERNMENT PROGRAMS THAN TO CUT TAXES.
ALL AUTHORITY SHOULD BE DERIVED FROM THE PEOPLE.
A BETTER WORLD WILL COME ABOUT ONLY THROUGH THE APPLICATION OF RATIONAL SCIENTIFIC PRINCIPLES.
TRADITIONS ARE OF NO IMPORTANCE IN A MODERN SOCIETY.
GUN OWNERSHIP SHOULD BE PROHIBITED UNLESS DONE FOR PURPOSES OF THE STATE.
IT’S A SAD REFLECTION ON OUR SOCIETY THAT SOMETHING AS FUNDAMENTAL AS HEALTHCARE REQUIRES A PROFIT MOTIVE.
PROTECTIONISM IS SOMETIMES NECESSARY TO PROTECT OUR NATION.
TAXPAYERS SHOULD NOT BE EXPECTED TO PROP UP ANY FAILING PRIVATE ENTERPRISE.
IT’S NATURAL FOR CHILDREN TO BE FREE FROM ALL FORMS OF ARBITRARY, AUTHORITARIAN PARENTING.
THE PRIME FUNCTION OF SCHOOLING SHOULD BE TO PREPARE THE STUDENT FOR FUTURE EMPLOYMENT.
WHAT’S GOOD FOR THE MOST SUCCESSFUL CORPORATIONS IS GOOD FOR THE NATION.
IN A CIVILISED SOCIETY, ONE MUST ALWAYS HAVE PEOPLE WHOM THEY CAN LOOK UP TO.
THE BUSINESSPERSON AND THE MANUFACTURER ARE MORE TO BE TRUSTED THAN THE PHILOSOPHER OR THE ARTIST.
ALMOST ALL POLITICIANS PROMISE ECONOMIC GROWTH, BUT WE SHOULD HEED THE WARNINGS OF ECONOMISTS ABOUT THE LIMITS OF GROWTH.
SOME PEOPLE ARE BORN TO RULE, AND OTHERS ARE BORN TO BE RULED.
